UNITED STATES PATENT AND TRADEMARK OFFICE
Patent 11,842,905 B2 — granted 12 December 2023

APPARATUS FOR ASYMMETRIC FIELD PROPULSION

Abstract: An apparatus is disclosed comprising a resonant cavity, an asymmetric
dielectric insert, and a drive circuit operable between 1.8 and 2.4 GHz. In
operation the apparatus is said to produce a net directional thrust in the
absence of propellant expulsion.

Claims: 18. Examiner: G. Nakamura. Art unit: 3646.

NOTE ON THE RECORD: grant establishes that the application met the office's
requirements for novelty, non-obviousness, and enablement as examined. The
office does not test the apparatus.
